name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kaku: Outbreak
name_english: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kaku: Outbreak
name_romanji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kaku: Outbreak
original_title: ひぐらしのなく頃に 拡 〜アウトブレイク〜
description: An OAV related to the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni series, known in English as "When They Cry". It is another re-telling of the terrible events occured in 1983 in the village of Hinamizawa and in particular of how the main characters dealt with the outbreak of a mysterious virus.
